mentions.name: Peak Flow Meter Diary
mentions.description: This app helps people with asthma record peak flow readings more easily and combines those records with environmental data to provide earlier warnings about possible triggers such as weather, pollen, pollution, cold air, and storms. It aims to make daily tracking easier, show simple visual warnings and notifications, and make it easier to share useful records with clinicians. The project also aims to reduce paper, plastic, and electronic waste, with a longer-term goal of being carbon-negative.
mentions.problem: People with asthma find it hard to record peak flow readings consistently and to anticipate environmental triggers; asthma affects an estimated 7.2 million people in the UK and, per WHO, 363 million people globally in 2023, causing 442,000 deaths.
mentions.audience: people with asthma (patients), clinicians, and carers
